title: Rep. Jennifer McClellan Disclosed a $50K-$100K Verizon Sale
content:
Rep. Jennifer McClellan (VA-4) disclosed one stock sale on November 20, 2026: Verizon (VZ), sold November 19 in the $50,001–$100,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Nov 19VZVerizon Communications Inc. (VZ)Sale, $50,001–$100,000$45.74 vs. $46.45 (+1.55%)

Transaction date: Nov 19, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 20, 2026 (1 day later). Member: Rep. Jennifer McClellan, VA-4 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • One sale: Verizon Communications (VZ), $50,001–$100,000, on November 19.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Verizon about 1.6% higher on November 23 than at the sale date.
  • Timing: the filing came one day after the trade, far inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
One day after the trade, which was dated November 19. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 23 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
